# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c11 P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v1 c34 P25](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0025), [v2 c11 P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Andrews  <sub>[v2 c11 P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000)</sub>; Mrs. Inglis  <sub>[v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is a plain, placid, pink-cheeked woman. She is described as having fat hands.

_Sources: [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Personality

Jane is plain, sensible, plodding, and conscientious, possessing a practical and pragmatic outlook on life. She is a placid, amiable woman whose milk of human kindness remains uncurled by life. Though not brilliant and rarely making notable remarks, she is kindly and never says anything to hurt others' feelings.

_Sources: [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Goals

- To earn a First Class teacher's license  <sub>[v1 c34 P25](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0025)</sub>

## History

Jane grew up in Avonlea and attended school alongside Anne Shirley and her circle of friends. She participated in local childhood games, including a dramatization of Tennyson's Elaine on the pond. Later, she attended Queen's Academy in Kingsport to study for her teacher's license, though she often found teaching to be monotonous. After her education, she engaged in teaching work. Eventually, she met and married Mr. Inglis, a wealthy English millionaire who had made money in mines. Despite her newfound wealth and silken, jewel-adorned lifestyle, she returned to Avonlea prior to Anne's wedding to visit her old friends, remaining as amiable, un-spoiled, and interested in Anne's happiness as ever.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002), [v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 c34 P20](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0020), [v1 c34 P21](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0021), [v2 c11 P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v3 c39 P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_
